a: Of the Civil Magistrate’s Power in Matters Ecclesiastical
We believe with our hearts and confess with our mouths
x: therefore, not imitable. Against such usurpation the Lord witnessed by smiting Uzziah with leprosy for presuming to offer incense
That none may usurp or execute a ministry but such as are rightly called by the church whereof they stand ministers
…civil magistrate may not assume to himself the administration of the Word and sacraments, or the power of the keys of the kingdom of heaven
